name: Remittance Advice V 07
definition: The RemittanceAdvice message allows the originator to provide remittance details that can be associated with a payment.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all remittance information included in the message.

RemittanceInformation.name: Remittance Information
RemittanceInformation.definition: Provides information to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the associated payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system, tax obligations, or garnishment orders.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
